name: wsl-reveal-explorer
description: Seamlessly open Windows File Explorer from WSL with zero configuration. Right-click any file or folder to reveal it in Windows Explorer.

wsl-reveal-explorer.defaultDistributionN.description: Override the auto-detected WSL distribution name (e.g., 'Ubuntu-22.04', 'Ubuntu2'). Not used for Windows drive paths like /mnt/c/..., which always open as C:\.... Leave empty to use automatic detection.

wsl-reveal-explorer.pathMappings.markdownDescription: Remote SSH: map remote folders to Windows paths. Each key is a remote path, each value is the Windows path it is shared as. The longest matching key wins. Example: `{ "D:\\": "\\\\host\\proj1", "/home/me/projects": "\\\\server\\projects" }`

wsl-reveal-explorer.pathPrefix.description: Legacy: path prefix for network paths. Use '\\wsl$' for WSL. For Remote SSH, prefer 'pathMappings'; this prefix is only used when no mapping matches, e.g. '\\server\share'.

wsl-reveal-explorer.customCommand.description: Custom command to open folders. Use {path} as placeholder for the folder path. Leave empty to use default Windows Explorer.
